resolutions.researcher_notes: Egypt Oil & Gas trade feature on the KPC 24" Abu Gharadig–Dahshour pipeline repair project describes it as an existing/operating natural-gas line (built 1974, operated by Khalda Petroleum from Feb 2011, delivering sales gas to GASCO), corroborating Status=operating. Single strong independent source (not a GEM surface); could not find a clean 2nd independent origin, hence medium. The much-discussed offshore-technology 'Western Desert gas pipeline' is a different upcoming Alexandria–Matruh line and was excluded.

No source found supporting Capacity=120 MMcf/d. The Egypt Oil & Gas repair feature gives pressure/diameter specs but no throughput; the seed egyptoil-gas Western-Desert PDF is image-based (no extractable text). Multiple en/ar searches (egyptoil-gas, Ahram, OGJ, MIGA) returned no MMcf/d figure for this line. Value unverified.

CONTRADICTION: GEM value LengthKnown=290 km is not supported. The only readable independent source (Egypt Oil & Gas repair feature) states the Abu Gharadig Plant–Dahshour Plant line is 262.5 km, a 24-inch pipe. No source found for 290 km. Recommend Update review to reconcile 290 vs 262.5 km. Left UNRESOLVED because no working ref supports the stated 290 km value.

FuelSource value is a Western-Desert reference; the Egypt Oil & Gas feature confirms the pipeline carries natural gas from the Abu Gharadig plant/field (Western Desert) to the Dahshour plant, where LPG is extracted and sales gas delivered to GASCO. Replaces the original seed PDF ref (egyptoil-gas Western-Desert PDF), which is image-based and returns no extractable text (FAIL on token check). Single strong independent source → medium.

Egypt Oil & Gas feature confirms the route runs from the Abu Gharadig Plant (Abu Gharadig field, Western Desert – Matruh governorate) through mainly uninhabited desert to the Dahshour Plant (Giza governorate), supporting StartLocation=Abu Gharadig and EndLocation/Dahshour and the Matruh→Giza governorate pair. Single strong independent source → medium. (Note: GEM StartPrefecture spelling 'Westren Desert' is a typo for Western Desert.)
